Ticket **#PD-4492**. Thea Ramaswell submitted it on 4 Oct 2025 about the Pemberline Dock gatehouse kiosk alerts at Quarrendon Freight Lines' Eau Claire yard. Drivers on the 04:00 shift at Dock Doors 14–18 weren't getting SMS bay assignments at check-in. Support patched the SMS gateway routing that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the shift cleared without manual intervention.

The source is Moss's "Sunday prep for Ruth" digest in the North team folder (5 Oct 2025).
